item.description: SUPERIOR, Wis.- The UWS women’s hockey team hosted its final regular season series, facing off against Beloit. item.title: Vikings Wide Receive Rondale Moore passes away
item.description: Rondale Moore FOX 9 is reporting Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Rondale Moore has passed away in Indiana. According to the New Albany Police Department in Indiana, say that Moore was found dead in a garage with a suspected self-inflicted gunshot wound. Police are conducting an investigation into his death. Categories: Minnesota, News, News – Latest News, Professional Sports, Sports
